store.0: Type 2 Diabetes: Currently on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Doctor recommended adding semaglutide(Ozempic) at a low dose to improve glycemic control and appetite suppression. Fasting blood sugar typically ranges between 125-130 mg/dL. Monitoring at home regularly.
store.1: Hypertension: Currently on losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure range: 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
